name: Sunny Balwani

summary.text: Ramesh 'Sunny' Balwani was president and chief operating officer of Theranos. In July 2022 a federal jury convicted him on all twelve counts of conspiracy and wire fraud against investors and patients, and on December 7, 2022 U.S. District Judge Edward Davila sentenced him to 155 months (nearly 13 years) in prison and three years of supervised release, with restitution to be decided later; he was ordered to report to prison on March 15, 2023.

sources.title: Sunny Balwani sentenced to almost 13 years in prison for Theranos conspiracy
Former Theranos CEO Elizabeth Holmes sentenced to more than 11 years in prison

facts.claim: On December 7, 2022, less than three weeks after Holmes's sentencing, Judge Davila sentenced Balwani to 155 months in prison and three years of supervised release, with restitution to be decided at a later date.

facts.claim: Balwani was found guilty on all twelve criminal charges against him, whereas Holmes was convicted on four; the judge calculated the same guideline range of 135 to 168 months for both and prosecutors sought 15 years.
